referenceGeometry.coverage: Eight nominal feature points and eight nominal ground-projected crossing references only; no complete obstacle, corridor, aperture, pickup-state or robot-approach geometry.
auditLimitations: Hub and Depot references are not robot goals, approach poses, scoring predicates or guaranteed pickup points.

BUMP references are not measured ramp centerlines or traversable paths. In the separately inspected welded STEP, nominal-versus-part midpoint differs by approximately 1.7935 mm laterally; no AndyMark CAD comparison was performed. No silent correction or physical path claim.
Welded and AndyMark frame origins are distinct; no automatic mirroring, variant substitution or frame transform.
The candidate welded CAD transform is not certified; no AndyMark CAD transform is inferred.
Source hashes establish attribution/consistency, not field acceptance, physical authenticity or robot reachability.
